In B, mentions "importance of approving the convention with status of constitutional amendment" and says "Deputado Aliel has been a great partner... one hour we will achieve." So both support ratification. So same proposition, same stance (favor). Thus STANCE_MAINTAINED.

But need to ensure both have determinable position on that specific proposition. Yes.
